map.发动机评分的权重怎么分布？: How is the engine score weighted?
map.启动、怠速、加速等核心工况权重较高，异响/渗漏等故障指征按严重程度计 0 并单列: Core conditions such as start, idle and acceleration weigh higher; fault signs like noise / leakage score 0 by severity and are listed separately; the total is weighted and mapped to excellent / good / fair / poor grades. Specific weights are built into each item's configuration.
